scope: Fixed public-synthetic textual classification screening; no production adapter, settings or default change

fixture.reference_kind: Synthetic author judgments independently reviewed by lead, not human ground truth
fixture.input_to_models: Exact model_input.state and model_input.questions only; IDs, references, tags and rationales withheld
fixture.target_choice_rule: Choice plus exact native task ID/revision; NONE/no-tasks normalize null; ignore always normalizes null

protocol_probe.state: Public protocol probe: the literal signal is BLUE.

probe.instructions: Which literal signal appears in the state?

hosted_protocol.latency_boundary: Request/client creation through observed response and client close; case percentiles exclude probe
hosted_protocol.confidence: Literal finite provider confidence, separate from selected-option probability; no synthesized answer_confidence

budget.billing_limit: usage.cost is provider-reported, not confirmed billing; full reservation retained

local_Laya.latency_boundary: Adapter completion plus pre/post identity checks; native HTTP forward-through-close separately retained

runtime.distribution: LM Studio llama.cpp AMD ROCm backend

guard_observation.diagnosis_basis: Source-order inference and final retained sample; outward native error is readiness-failed

limits: One conservative observer refusal during owned startup, not an inference-quality result.
No successful SystemOne request, actual input token count, full GPU placement or capacity result.
No observed OOM message; do not infer OOM, CPU fallback, backend estimator defect or general inability to fit.
Existing workloads stayed in place; this physical32GB coexistence observation is not an8GB/12GB whole-stack profile.

initial_review_blockers.issue: Escaped credential in allowed response ID could decode into persisted plaintext
initial_review_blockers.repair: Before persistence, scan bounded strict-decoded JSON strings and keys on every HTTP status; withhold raw and parsed echoes

initial_review_blockers.issue: Crash after fatal result fsync but before halt marker allowed another admission
initial_review_blockers.repair: Under phase lock, derive halt from all durable fatal results before credential access or a new reservation

offline_audit_regressions.scope: Private runner MockTransport, temporary ledgers and synthetic keys; not 109 model-quality trials

causes: Audit hashed enclosing fixture objects instead of the declared cases arrays
Audit reconstructed probe wire order from a sorted canonical declaration, rather than fixed model/state/questions/provider order
audit_only_corrections.correction: Audit-only expectations corrected to match documented canonical pin scope and exact fixed wire envelope; no evidence/source/fixture change

second_pass.cause: Probe outer order corrected first, but nested question object remained sorted from canonical declaration; corrected with independently written frozen literal probe

initial_focused.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/unit/test_decisions_model_screen.py

with_existing_Laya_regressions.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/unit/test_decisions_model_screen.py tests/unit/test_laya_provider.py tests/integration/test_laya_decisions.py

public_offline_tests.scope: Frozen-byte pins, actual pure native projection/mapping, request/sanitized-response digests and independent score/cost recomputation; related integration uses synthetic transports only

publication.frozen_fixture_files: Exact original bytes; pending/no-inference creation fields remain historical, not current outcome
publication.sanitized_body_hash_basis: Canonical UTF8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=false
publication.original_capture_hashes: Exact original request/response/file bytes, independently checked privately; not hashes of sanitized projections
publication.public_reproducibility: Recompute fixtures, exact request projections, sanitized-body digests and reported metrics; full raw-file verification requires retained private captures
redactions: local filesystem paths and process identities
publication.retained_metadata_limit: Filtered catalog and selected endpoint file pins verified; original full models-catalog HTTP body not retained, so its historical body digest cannot be independently recomputed

limitations: 48 manually authored consumed public synthetic textual cases are not broad reliability, human truth or held-out acceptance.
Confidence and selected-option probability are separate literals; no calibration or native policy threshold is qualified.
Typed intent with NONE target in seven predeclared cases differs from generic ambiguous-target ignore policy; target choice does not imply permission or dispatch.
All seven OpenRouter rows are hosted endpoints; closed cloud models are not demonstrated local backends.
Cloud and Laya latency boundaries differ and host/network conditions are uncontrolled.
Cloud usage.cost is provider-reported, confirmed billing remains null, and no irreversible reservation is released.
Laya disk/commit hashes do not attest Python imports at the existing worker start.
No8GB or12GB whole local GPU stack was qualified; physical32GB observation is not a16GB/32GB profile experiment.
Local D1 startup guard refusal produced no comparison inference or quality score and proves neither OOM nor general incompatibility.
No new inference, network, credentials, model lifecycle or production change occurred in preparing this publication.
